turns.text: My cat bit me hard on the hand yesterday — two deep puncture marks, now a bit sore and puffy. I'd like to get it seen. What's the fastest way to do that?
Why are cat bites on the hand taken so seriously compared with other cuts?
How should I care for it in the meantime — washing, covering, elevation?
If I went to urgent care, what would they do — antibiotics, tetanus?
What do hand specialists say are the signs that infection is spreading?
A friend says pharmacies can sometimes prescribe for minor infections. Is that true where I might be?
Someone else said telehealth can do a prescription the same day. How would that work?
I have no insurance and I've just started a job and can't take time off. What's the cheapest same-day option?
What should I say when I call so they understand it's a cat bite on the hand and see me quickly?
Could you give me a plan — how to get seen today, what to say, and how to care for it in the meantime?
